report:
Fresh source review of meta.reviews.fragment_associations after diagnostic assertions and associations changed. Complete claim requires independent comparison of complete association sets and metadata, with addition/removal/change invalidating even if saved fragment text remains unchanged. Reviewed the sole ordinary implementation association in review.rs and both complete ordinary associated tests; no TODO/N/A entries or deferred aspects. inventory constructs deterministic sorted/deduplicated implementation and test metadata vectors. Derived equality covers implementation crate, target, module, file, cfg, excerpt, region, status and explanation; test equality covers crate, target, Rust path, file, cfg and status. input_errors compares both vectors independently before inspecting initial/additional fragment contents. These comparisons catch set addition/removal symmetrically and field changes; record rejects errors, acceptable uses inputs_match, and validate forwards errors. Captured check.rs integrates those errors into review validity and overall is_valid/ensure_valid, without bypassing metadata checks. The check.rs delta consists of diagnostic associations and does not alter this behavior.

The complete added_or_removed_associations_invalidate_unchanged_saved_fragments test now strengthens each failure assertion: adding a second test and removing it after approval each call ensure_valid().unwrap_err() and assert anchor ID, test associations diagnostic, and review skill guidance. Adding a second implementation similarly asserts implementation associations and two enumerated implementation entries. It also checks deterministic test ordering and the unchanged first test identity. These explicit diagnostic assertions establish independent metadata comparisons more directly than the previous generic invalidity assertions. test_selector_preserves_metadata_and_ignores_unrelated_line_movement checks crate/target/path/file/cfg/status and captures exactly TEST, records a review, asserts unrelated lines preserve validity, then changes inherited unix cfg to windows outside the selected TEST and asserts rejection. Captured fixture helpers show src/tests.rs is not an implementation whole-file fragment, while claim, implementation source and selected TEST are unchanged. Thus the metadata-only qualification is meaningfully exercised. Test bodies expose their actual assertions; fixture helpers only construct/write/start/record/read the environment. The paired set-difference checks plus direct vector-equality implementation cover symmetric removal and other metadata changes without separate behavioral branches. No unresolved correctness or adequacy issue.

Personally executed fresh review start and read commands and inspected all initial source plus recaptured test helpers and check.rs. No source edits or tests/builds executed in this refresh. Earlier reviewer-run focused tests passed on earlier inputs; they are not asserted as execution of these newly strengthened assertions. Coordinator reports 331 sage-meta functional tests, 46 sage-stash tests and workspace build passed; that is separately reported execution, not personally executed evidence.
